## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Energy, Healthcare). Confirmations: weak overall breadth and narrow leadership concentration; mixed sector returns (Energy/Healthcare positive, most others negative).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +9.84%) ABOVE TREND, EOG (1W: +5.77% | 1M: +7.80%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare next: TMO (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +9.11%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +5.44%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +7.71% | 1M: -4.40%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Utilities weak: CEG (1W: -13.09% | 1M: -7.86%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary soft: TSLA (1W: -3.15% | 1M: +4.18%) CORRECTION; Industrials pressured: ETN (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -13.09%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -16.65%) BELOW TREND. Technology shows internal fractures with multiple large-cap downdrafts.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: PANW (1W: +11.31% | 1M: -2.39%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +13.63%) ABOVE TREND, ACN (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +9.33%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +13.89%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +7.71% | 1M: -4.40%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: ETN (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -13.09%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -6.72%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -13.67%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -16.65%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -9.45% | 1M: +4.35%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Technology and Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: PANW (1W: +11.31%), META (1W: +9.25%), ACN (1W: +8.03%), QCOM (1W: +7.88%), ISRG (1W: +7.71%). Major divergence present: multiple large-cap names (PANW, ISRG, GOOGL, LLY) show 1W vs 1M mismatch — tactical opportunities, not confirmation of regime shift.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed and fracturing: AAPL (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +8.31%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.54%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -5.66%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -13.67%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: weak (Tech appears to have low positive participation amid polarized leaders and laggards).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials soft overall: JPM (1W: -0.29% | 1M: -2.85%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +3.15%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +0.42% | 1M: +0.70%) ABOVE TREND — mixed internals and limited participation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare showing resilience but mixed internals: TMO (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +9.11%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +5.44%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -0.71% | 1M: +3.14%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: +1.09% | 1M: -3.73%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth: modest positive contribution keeping Healthcare among the two advancing sectors.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor exposure to Energy and selective Healthcare names showing ABOVE TREND strength; reduce exposure to concentrated Tech laggards showing confirmed BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — be selective given narrow top-end gains.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: META (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +13.63%) ABOVE TREND; XOM (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND; ACN (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +9.33%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -5.66%) BELOW TREND; AMAT (1W: -10.92% | 1M: -16.87%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -13.64% | 1M: -6.76%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth driving positive returns; XOM, CVX ABOVE TREND).  
BEARISH: Technology and Utilities (wider participation in declines; multiple large-cap tech names BELOW TREND).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
META: watch continuation above recent breakout levels to confirm ABOVE TREND follow-through. NVDA: watch for stabilization after below-trend slide; continued weakness would signal broader tech risk. XOM: hold above recent support to confirm Energy leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
D (1W: n/a | 1M: n/a) (+80): merger sweetener headline — cross-ref price: utilities name cited above but CEG is BELOW TREND, so watch for distribution/confirmation.  
XOM (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +6.44%) (+65): regulatory approval for CCS — price ABOVE TREND confirming accumulation.  
ISRG (1W: +7.71% | 1M: -4.40%) (+60): CE Mark win in gynecology — price in RECOVERY, sentiment aligns with short-term reversal.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
NKE (1W: n/a | 1M: n/a) (-55): headline on downdraft — cross-ref price: consumer discretionary names weak.  
GOOGL (1W: +1.96% | 1M: -0.20%) (-50): regulatory pressure headline — price in RECOVERY while sentiment is negative, divergence to monitor.  
GS (1W: n/a | 1M: n/a) (-50): fundraise headline — financials mixed; monitor for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology). META (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +13.63%) ABOVE TREND and Energy names XOM (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large caps (multiple RECOVERY and CORRECTION signals) and mixed news sentiment (GOOGL negative headlines vs selective Tech rallies) — watch for trend confirmation.
